description: This file defines the class DataElementFile, which is a part of the Thunder::Core namespace. The class represents a data element that manages a file, providing methods for file operations such as load, reload, unlink, destroy, and accessors for file properties. It includes constructors, destructors, and private members related to file handling, including memory-mapped file management.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: Represents a file data element with capabilities to load, reload, unlink, destroy, and manage file properties, including support for memory-mapped files.
